hotels.title: Barwon Heads Golf Retreat 90-Minutes from Melbourne with Championship Course, Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Get ready to unwind in luxury at a stunning golf retreat nestled along Victoria’s iconic Bellarine Peninsula. This exceptional Barwon Heads hotel offers an unparalleled experience for golf enthusiasts, featuring two award-winning courses maintained to the highest standards year-round. Home to the prestigious Victoria Open and located just moments from pristine beaches, it provides the perfect setting to practice your swing and enjoy breathtaking coastal views. When you upgrade your package, enjoy the added perk of one round of 18 holes during your stay. When you're not on the course, indulge in gourmet dining at the hotel's modern clubhouse restaurant, where you can savour delicious meals while overlooking the expansive Beach Course. For those seeking adventure, the nearby Thirteenth Beach offers fantastic surf conditions, or you can simply relax with a serene sunset walk along the shore.
